scope: BM-171 only — no BM-001 modification, no mass rollout, no PR7B
rationaleShort: Planner eyeballed the rendered DOCX and rejected it because notes 12/13 (template drafter instructions) are still visible, page-1 has a suspicious huge blank gap before QUYẾT ĐỊNH, and page-2 overflow contains Nơi nhận + Lưu + the drafter notes. Source vs rendered DOCX parts inspection proves: (1) notes 12/13 are NOT footnotes or endnotes — no word/footnotes.xml or word/endnotes.xml parts exist; they are body <w:p> paragraphs (P0080/P0081 in legacy .doc, paragraphs 86/87 in rendered DOCX) with <w:vertAlign w:val="superscript"/> runs; (2) the renderer did NOT introduce them — they are inherited verbatim from the source normalized DOCX; (3) the page-1 huge blank and page-2 overflow are caused by 9 empty legal-basis placeholder paragraphs each carrying w:spacing w:beforeLines/afterLines="50" plus a positional line-drawing in paragraph 15 for the tiêu-ngữ underline.

sourceVsRenderedParts.note: Body part. The rendered one is larger because docxtemplater expands the placeholder runs and the dotted-instruction macros add a few thousand bytes.
No real Word footnotes anywhere. The audit verdict should be NOT_PRESENT, not NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_TEMPLATE.
No real Word endnotes anywhere. Same audit-verdict correction as above.

pageSetup.note: Page 2 in the rendered DOCX is purely a Word overflow artifact. There is no explicit <w:br w:type="page"/> anywhere in the source or rendered DOCX. The tight bottom margin (288 twips) plus the empty legal-basis placeholder paragraphs and the positional line-drawing for the tiêu-ngữ underline add up to bottom-margin overflow.

word/endnotes.xml does not exist in the DOCX package. Same reason.
word/comments.xml does not exist in the DOCX package.
No header*.xml or footer*.xml parts exist.
Only <w:drawing> in the body is the line geometry for the tiêu-ngữ underline at paragraph 15. Notes 12/13 are not inside any drawing.

The 'Ghi cụ thể cơ quan...' and 'Ghi chức danh người ký' texts are subsequent <w:r> runs at the same paragraph level. These paragraphs live AFTER paragraph 48 ('Lưu: HSVA, HSKS, VP.') and BEFORE <w:sectPr> (end-of-document). A stretch of 37 empty paragraphs (50–85) sits between paragraph 48 and paragraph 86.

bm001Precedent.behaviour: BM-001's visual sign-off treats these drafter-note paragraphs as EXPECTED_BY_TEMPLATE. The BM-001 final audit docxParts.footnotes: NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_TEMPLATE (separators only).

notesExpectedOrSuppress.definitiveAnswer: Notes 12/13 are body paragraphs in the source normalized DOCX. They are inherited verbatim through the renderer. There are no real Word footnotes or endnotes.
notesExpectedOrSuppress.optionA: EXPECTED_BY_TEMPLATE — mirror BM-001 precedent. No code change. Update visual sign-off packet to formalize that the notes are by-template.
notesExpectedOrSuppress.optionB: MUST_SUPPRESS — add a per-BM suppression rule. Implementation choices: (1) mutate normalized DOCX [FORBIDDEN without explicit user authorization per AGENTS.md]; (2) per-BM body-tail-clipper rule in the renderer/contract render plan [PR6G-level change]; (3) per-BM body-tail-drop rule in the BM-171 style profile [requires new style-rule kind in PR6G.4 generic engine].
notesExpectedOrSuppress.agentDecision: NOT MADE — deferred to Planner per direct user instruction in §13 of triage MD.

spacingDiagnosis.phenomenon: Page 1 has a suspicious huge blank spacing before QUYẾT ĐỊNH: (paragraph 30).
spacingDiagnosis.mechanism: Rendered DOCX paragraphs 21–29 are 9 consecutive empty paragraphs, all carrying <w:spacing w:before="192" w:beforeLines="50" w:after="192" w:afterLines="50" w:line="320" w:lineRule="exact"/>. They are the legal-basis placeholder block (locked contract slots 5–12: official.issuerTitle, legalBasis.procedureArticlesLine, caseDecision.*, accusedDecision.*, assetReturn.investigationConclusionLegalBasisLine, assetReturn.caseSuspensionDecisionLegalBasisLine, assetReturn.accusedSuspensionDecisionLegalBasisLine, assetReturn.considerationLine). The canonical fixture fills only 4 of 34 slots, so 27 placeholders expand to empty paragraphs.
spacingDiagnosis.additionalContributor: Paragraph 15 is a positional line-drawing element (<w:drawing> with <wps:wsp>/<a:prstGeom prst="line"/>) that visually underlines paragraph 14 ("Độc lập - Tự do - Hạnh phúc") — a Word-pagination artifact from the legacy .doc → .docx normalization that adds a small amount of vertical space.
spacingDiagnosis.additionalRendering: 9 × ((50/100) line before + 320 twips line + (50/100) line after) ≈ 1.04 inch of vertical body space from these empty legal-basis paragraphs alone.
spacingDiagnosis.fix: NOT DECIDED. Sub-fix A: future BM-171 panel exposes those 27 legal-basis slots so the user fills them in their case and the empty paragraphs become real text — no renderer change. Sub-fix B: add a <w:collapseEmptyParagraphs> rule in the BM-171 style profile — requires a new style-rule kind in the PR6G.4 generic engine. Sub-fix C: edit normalized DOCX to remove the paragraphs — FORBIDDEN per AGENTS.md unless explicitly authorized.

page2Diagnosis.phenomenon: Page 2 is mostly empty and contains Nơi nhận:, Lưu: HSVA, HSKS, VP., and notes 12/13.
page2Diagnosis.mechanism: Rendered DOCX paragraphs 50–85 are 37 empty paragraphs (legacy recipients + signature + residual spacing that the source DOCX carries as blank templates). When Word/Office paginates A4 with top=864 + bottom=288 = 1152 twips of margins, the cumulative empty-placeholder + empty-spacing height overflows the bottom margin. There is no explicit <w:br w:type="page"/> anywhere; the page-2 placement is a Word overflow artifact.
page2Diagnosis.whyNoiNhanOnPage2: Page 1's body content (paragraphs 0–48) plus the cumulative empty-paragraph and line-drawing overhead exceeds the available vertical space in the running render. Word pushes paragraphs 46 (Nơi nhận), 48 (Lưu), 49–85 (empty), and 86–87 (notes 12/13) to page 2. The Planner eyeball confirms this in the actual Word render.
page2Diagnosis.fix: Same as spacingDiagnosis — Sub-fix A (user fills slots) collapses this naturally. Sub-fix B requires a PR6G.4 engine change.

answeringPlannerDemand.question: Trong BM-171, dòng 12/13 là: (1) footnotes/endnotes hợp pháp phải giữ, (2) instruction notes phải remove khỏi output, hay (3) body content do source template đang chứa?

option1LegalFootnotesEndnotes.evidence: word/footnotes.xml and word/endnotes.xml are absent from the package. No <w:footnote> or <w:endnote> elements exist.

option2SuppressFromOutput.evidence: The locked contract has 34 docxSlots and binds none to P0080/P0081. So the contract view says these paragraphs are template residue. The domain view says BM-001/BM-169/BM-170 carry the same drafter-note shape and BM-001 treats it as EXPECTED_BY_TEMPLATE. Decision requires Planner.

option3BodyContentFromSource.evidence: Paragraphs 86 and 87 of word/document.xml in both source and rendered DOCX. <w:vertAlign w:val="superscript"/> runs for the digits 12 and 13. Plain body runs for 'Ghi cụ thể cơ quan, người có thẩm quyền bảo quản, xử lý vật chứng; cơ quan, tổ chức, cá nhân có liên quan' and 'Ghi chức danh người ký'. Inherited verbatim from source.

blockers.title: Notes 12/13 visibility requires source-of-truth policy decision
blockers.detail: BM-171 has no real Word footnotes or endnotes. Notes 12/13 are body paragraphs in source word/document.xml. Whether they are EXPECTED_BY_TEMPLATE (Path A, mirror BM-001) or MUST_SUPPRESS (Path B, add a per-BM suppression rule) is a Planner decision, not an agent decision.

blockers.title: Page-1 huge blank spacing before QUYẾT ĐỊNH:
blockers.detail: 9 consecutive empty legal-basis-placeholder paragraphs (rendered paragraphs 21–29) each carry w:spacing w:beforeLines="50" w:afterLines="50". Combined with the line-drawing underline element at paragraph 15, this produces ~1 inch of empty body space between paragraph 18 (date line) and paragraph 30 (QUYẾT ĐỊNH:). Source structure, not a renderer bug.

blockers.title: Page-2 empty contains Nơi nhận + Lưu + notes 12/13
blockers.detail: Rendered paragraphs 46 (Nơi nhận), 48 (Lưu: HSVA, HSKS, VP.), 86 (note 12), 87 (note 13) all spill to page 2 because the cumulative empty-paragraph overhead plus the tight bottom margin (288 twips) overflows the page-1 body. No explicit page break exists. Source structure, not a renderer bug.

blockers.title: audit-bm-final.mjs evidence wording is misleading for BM-171
blockers.detail: docs/audit/bm-final/BM-171/final.latest.{json,md} evidence note says 'word/footnotes.xml (or endnotes.xml) carries only Word-emitted separator entries (-1 and 0)'. That note is generic and assumes the part exists; in BM-171 there is NO footnotes.xml part at all. The audit verdict for footnotes / endnotes should be reclassified from NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_TEMPLATE to NOT_PRESENT (or equivalent) to match reality.
